display_name: 独立 IQ 流 GPU 训练
description: 以单条 received IQ 为锚点，用源 clean IQ 训练路径速度，四步确定性积分。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU2 FP32 TF32off deterministic source training; CPU ground

data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: New 28162-parameter velocity network, zero output head; no DURA weights in trainable model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Validated source context exact ordered 32768 fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target; DURA fields loaded but not used in direct objective
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed source IQ context has no target ancestry; training controller loads frozen DURA for smoke and source evaluation
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch twenty, no target or pilot-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only; wait for >=4096 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve other jobs
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.purpose: Train a direct conditional IQ flow using source received and source clean IQ
rows.seed_notes: Initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611; order 2026110613; flow time 2026110713; evaluation 2026092701
rows.budget_ref: 28162 trainable parameters; 32768 source IDs x three views x twenty epochs, batch32

notes: Uniform source t and linear received-to-clean interpolation; velocity target clean-received; four fixed Euler inference steps.
Direct network objective and inference use only the received IQ, not DURA fields; reused source cache contains DURA tensors and controller loads DURA for smoke/source evaluation.
No F/TX/V/target in recovery training; fixed last checkpoint, no target selection or tuning.
Historical R03 deterministic flow used F guidance and different classifier; its result cannot be attributed to this candidate.
All seven 168000-record Phase1 predictions must finish before independent truth-last; compare frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL DURA. Ground evaluation also computes DURA for matched control.
GPU2 queue waits for fewer than three total compute apps and at least 4096 MiB free; preserve other owners.
Technical stop on invalid input, provenance failure, non-finite/OOM, output conflict, smoke, prediction or scoring failure; no automatic retry.
